title: Stage Validation
description: Result of main-agent adversarial validation. Produces a pending machine-evidence bundle or kills the lead; only the main agent can semantically confirm it. Later records the patch.

finding_id.description: Case ID from the casefile ledger

status.description: Validation status: pending_confirmation (machine PoC bundle passed and awaits main-agent review), killed (failed), or reported (patched)

technique_used.description: The specific technique/payload used in the PoC

detection_method.description: How success was detected (timing, error message, response content, OOB callback, etc.)

poc_path.description: Path to the PoC script on disk (required when pending_confirmation)

run_log.description: Summary of the PoC output and machine differential (required when pending_confirmation)

evidence_extracted.description: Data extracted or state changed that supports the pending claim; this stage output does not decide confirmation

kill_reason.description: Reason the finding was killed (required when killed)

refinement_attempts.description: Number of refinement attempts before success or kill
